answer: Re-attestations are stored in saffron and delta lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 19 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the lagoon graph. A farm of 2336 identities would post 4273 proofs and burn roughly 45 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
